summary: Iteration 3 — validated the new features layered on top of the crew module. NEW: Owner Dashboard Work calendar, Airtable Job Time Log auto-mirror with pending-queue behavior, truck management upgrade (name + plate + delete-with-confirm), assignment job_size dropdown, and console-noise fix for crew view. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py — 13/13 passed. E2E: owner login → set Truck 1 plate NJX-1234 → create QA Cal Move (3BR, Truck 1, Javante DRIVER + Junior HELPER, ignore warnings). Javante clocked in on the assignment, advanced En Route → Arrived → In Progress → opened Finish dialog → typed note → Mark complete → clocked out. Owner Dashboard calendar for today showed a dot on the day; clicking it rendered the QA Cal Move cal-job-card with Javante Brown DRIVER + Junior Santil HELPER chips, Size: 3BR, 2 crew, 'Truck 1 · NJX-1234', notes, and hours (0h 0m — punches were <1 min apart). Sync badge showed 'Airtable key missing' consistently (expected). Truck ADD (name+plate) → visible + in Assign dropdown → REMOVE opens confirm-remove-truck dialog → confirmed → gone + removed from dropdown + toast preserves history. Console 403 count while logged in as crew = 0 (the 8x-403 regression is fixed). Backend regression: 28/29 previous-suite tests still pass (the 1 known test_create_reset_deactivate_user duplicate-email idempotency artifact — pre-documented). Cleanup: QA Cal Move deleted, Truck 1 plate reset to empty, 2 stale TEST_QA_Truck_ZZ trucks removed, timelog pending count returned to 0. One CRITICAL frontend bug found: the Finish-job dialog does NOT render delay-factor checkboxes.

minor.issue: pending_jobs entries only include job_name/job_date/error — no assignment_id. Two jobs with the same job_name+date would be indistinguishable in the badge tooltip and telemetry. Suggest adding assignment_id to pending_jobs for observability.

ui_bugs.issue: Delay-factor checkboxes are NOT rendered in the Finish-job dialog. Code declares DELAY_FACTORS, factors state, toggleFactor handler, and imports Checkbox — but the JSX in lines 152-166 renders only the notes Textarea + Mark complete. Also, the Mark-complete onClick calls advance('Complete', notes) without passing factors, so even if the user could toggle them, they would never be sent to the backend. Result: crew cannot record delay factors from the UI; the cal-delay-chip section on the owner calendar will always be empty. Playwright confirmed 0 elements matched [data-testid='delay-factor-option']. Backend accepts delay_factors correctly (verified with pytest), so this is purely a rendering bug.

design_issues.screen: Owner Dashboard — console noise (owner view only)
issues: When Airtable key is empty, the Dashboard fires periodic Airtable-proxy calls (via Squarish poller + tables refreshes) and the browser logs 10+ 'Failed to load resource: 503' messages. Crew view is now clean (0 x 403). Not a bug, just noise. Owner-side probes could also be role/health-gated to only fire when health.airtable_configured is true.

action_items: HIGH — Fix CrewJobs.jsx Finish dialog: render the delay-factor checkboxes (data-testid='delay-factor-option') using the existing DELAY_FACTORS + toggleFactor + Checkbox, and change the Mark-complete onClick from advance('Complete', notes) to advance('Complete', notes, factors) so factors are actually sent to POST /api/crew/jobs/{id}/status. Also reset factors state when dialog closes.
LOW — Add assignment_id to /api/timelog/status pending_jobs response for better observability.
LOW — Role/health-gate the owner-side Airtable-proxy polls when health.airtable_configured is false to eliminate the 10x 503 console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: CrewJobs.jsx line 152-166 — the Finish dialog is missing the checkbox render block. The imported Checkbox + DELAY_FACTORS + factors/toggleFactor are dead code. This is the root cause of the delay-factors-not-recorded bug.

server.py is now 1947 lines (up from 1717 last iteration). Still well past the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting into modules (auth, users, trucks, assignments, timelog, calendar, crew, storage, business).

server.py /api/trucks endpoint DOES delete (mongo.delete_one), which is the desired semantics for the new Remove button — good. But note that the delete is hard: past assignments keep their frozen truck_name copy on the assignment doc (verified in test); however if any future code path relied on trucks.find({_id: X}) it would 404 for old truck ids.
server.py timelog_status doesn't include assignment_id in pending_jobs — see minor backend issue.

Timelog retry loop runs every ~60s; there is no exponential backoff/dead-letter — with empty AIRTABLE_API_KEY every pending row will be re-processed indefinitely. Fine for preview, but consider a max-attempts cap or 5xx-vs-4xx branching in production.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the delay-factors bug: developer added the DELAY_FACTORS constant, factors state and toggleFactor handler + Checkbox import to CrewJobs.jsx JobCard, and wired the backend/data models (StatusPayload.delay_factors, calendar echo, delay-factor chips, DELAY_FACTORS whitelist), but forgot to render the actual checkbox UI inside <DialogContent data-testid='complete-job-dialog'>. Result: JSX only shows the Textarea + confirm button; the Mark-complete onClick calls advance('Complete', notes) instead of advance('Complete', notes, factors). Fix: after the <Textarea>, insert a small grid of <label><Checkbox data-testid='delay-factor-option' checked={factors.includes(fct)} onCheckedChange={() => toggleFactor(fct)}/> {fct}</label> for each DELAY_FACTORS entry, then change the onClick to advance('Complete', notes, factors) and reset factors + notes when the dialog closes.
